facts.fact: Russia has committed to finance phases 3 and 4 of the African Center for Research in Artificial Intelligence (CARIA) in Congo through a Sberbank debt-to-development conversion, with funds not yet disbursed, according to the Congolese minister.

facts.fact: The Congo's AI strategy technical committee, launched on 6 May 2026 with UNDP technical and financial support, is to produce a structured digital corpus for Lingala and Kituba within its six-month mandate, with a budget of 150 to 200 million FCFA sought, as reported by Les Depeches de Brazzaville.

facts.fact: Congo Digital Services published an 884-pair Lingala OCR image-text dataset for training a vision-language model, created in August 2026 with UNDP Congo and the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy, under the NOODL-1.0 licence with gated access.

Congo Digital Services published the weights of a Lingala-tuned Llama 3.1 8B model on 27 July 2026, developed for the MALOBA project with UNDP Republic of Congo, with its end-to-end endpoint still to be validated.

RFI reports that the Congolese state is finishing a data centre in Bacongo, Brazzaville, financed largely by the African Development Bank, which a ministry adviser says can host supercomputers to train AI models for local startups.
